title: Without The Guru, The World Is Drowning
summary: The shabad does not leave greed at diagnosis. It turns toward return.
takeaway: Without the Guru, the world is drowning
lifeApplication: Ask what you are taking in that still leaves the heart poor. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.

source.shortMeaning: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to; without the Guru, the world is drowning
source.lifeApplication: Return begins when the later line is allowed to outlast the first rush of feeling.

evidence.coreClaim: The swan of the soul takes flight, and asks which way to; without the Guru, the world is drowning
evidence.turn: Greed steadies when without the Guru, the world is drowning.
evidence.practicalImplication: Ask what you are taking in that still leaves the heart poor. After the reaction, make the next return smaller and truer.
